events.title: The new decade begins with 아스널 beating 크리스털 팰리스 4–1 at Highbury to cut 리버풀's lead at the top of the First Division, as 케니 달글리시 's men are held 2–2 at the City Ground by 노팅엄 포리스트. Title challenge outsiders 사우샘프턴 win 4–2 at bottom club 찰턴 애슬레틱. In the Second Division, Steve Bull scores four goals as 울버햄프턴 원더러스 win 4–1 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, a result which boosts his side's challenge for a unique third successive promotion, and also drags promotion favourites 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 out of the top six. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 maintain their hopes of an immediate return to the First Division by beating 반즐리 4–2 at Upton Park.
Ray Harford resigns after two and a half years as manager of 루턴 타운 to be succeeded by his assistant Jimmy Ryan .
스윈던 타운 chairman Brian Hillier and former manager Lou Macari are suspected of making an illegal bet against their own club in an FA Cup tie with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in January 1988.
Third Division 노샘프턴 타운 cause the shock of the FA Cup third round by beating the 1987 winners 코번트리 시티 1–0. 리버풀 are held 0–0 by 스완지 시티 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 1–0 at the City Ground in the third round of the FA Cup, with Mark Robins scoring the winning goal. The football press had widely tipped manager 알렉스 퍼거슨 to be sacked if United had been beaten.
리버풀 thrash 스완지 시티 8–0 in their FA Cup third round replay. Second Division leaders 리즈 유나이티드 pay 노팅엄 포리스트 £400,000 for striker Lee Chapman .
맨체스터 유나이티드's winless run in the First Division stretches to eight matches when they lose 2–1 at home to 더비 카운티.
더비 카운티 replace Paul Goddard with Mick Harford in a £500,000 move from 루턴 타운.
아스널 sign defender Colin Pates from Brighton & Hove Albion for £500,000.
맨체스터 유나이티드 are now without a win from their last nine matches in the First Division with a 2–0 defeat at 노리치 시티, which leaves them just one point and one place above the relegation zone.
Almost two months after being sacked as player–manager by 퀸스 파크 레인저스, Trevor Francis signs for 셰필드 웬즈데이.

첼시 are beaten 3–1 by 브리스틀 시티 in the FA Cup fourth round. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat First Division opposition for the second round running, winning 1–0 against 찰턴 애슬레틱. 애스턴 빌라 remain in contention for the double by beating 포트 베일 6–0 at Villa Park. 크리스털 팰리스 beat 허더즈필드 타운 4–0.

A Clayton Blackmore goal gives 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–0 win their FA Cup fourth round tie with Hereford at Edgar Street . 노리치 시티 hold 리버풀 to a goalless draw at Carrow Road and 에버턴 beat 셰필드 웬즈데이 2–1 at Hillsborough.

The Taylor Report , an inquiry into stadium safety following the Hillsborough disaster nine months ago, recommends that all First and Second Division stadiums are all–seater by 1994 and that the Third and Fourth Divisions follow suit by 1999. 코번트리 시티 pay a club record £900,000 for 23–year–old 던디 유나이티드 and Scotland striker Kevin Gallacher .
In their FA Cup fourth round replay at the Abbey Stadium , Fourth Division 케임브리지 유나이티드 spring a major surprise by beating First Division 밀월 1–0.

퀸스 파크 레인저스 beat 아스널 2–0 in an FA Cup fourth round replay. 리버풀 end January as First Division leaders on goal difference ahead of 애스턴 빌라, who have a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are still just one place above the relegation zone, occupied by 찰턴 애슬레틱, 루턴 타운 and 밀월. The race to get into the First Division is headed by 리즈 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드, who are further distancing themselves from the rest of the Second Division. Just two points separate the next five clubs – 스윈던 타운, 올덤 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 입스위치 타운. Meanwhile, eighth placed 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are just two points short of the playoff zone and are looking like reasonable challengers for a unique third successive promotion.
